title: ChIPseqSpikeInFree-bigwig-nf pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

bigwig.errorMessage: bigWig must be a local path or an http(s)/ftp URL ending in .bw or .bigWig (no spaces). A local file must exist; a URL is read in place with range requests

reads.errorMessage: Optional 'reads' is the number of mapped reads in the sample (a whole number); it sets the pseudo read total. Samples with fewer than 1e6 reads are dropped, as in ChIPseqSpikeInFree

antibody.errorMessage: Antibody must be provided (e.g. H3K27me3, INPUT) and may not contain tabs or commas

group.errorMessage: Group must be provided (e.g. WT, KO) and may not contain tabs or commas

color.errorMessage: Color is an R colour name or hex code (e.g. grey, #1B9E77)
